info.name: 366PI Recruitment Platform - Complete Endpoints Collection
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman API Collection covering 100% of all endpoints across all 7 microservices in the 366PI Recruitment Platform architecture:

1. Discovery Server (Eureka :8761)
2. Admin Server (Spring Boot Admin :8082)
3. Auth Service (:8083)
4. User Service (:8081)
5. Job Service (:8084)
6. Application Service (:8085)
7. Interview Service (:8086)

All endpoints include realistic JSON payloads, query parameters, path variables, required authentication headers (X-Candidate-Id, X-Admin-Id, Bearer token), and automated Postman test scripts that dynamically populate collection variables.
